content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Ashley Roberts (E016) requests write access to Payroll.

Two notes:
- HR note: role Analyst, full_time, recommendation write.
- Security note: role Analyst, contractor, basic security training, recommendation read. Security DB is authoritative for employment type/training.

Policy:
- full_time: up to write, admin only if role owns system. Analyst doesn't own Payroll (Payroll Specialist owns it). So full_time max = write.
- contractor: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. Basic training → max read.

Security note says Security DB is authoritative for employment type/training. So Ashley is a contractor with basic security training. Max = read.

Requested = write, which exceeds max read. So grant maximum = read.

I'll submit decision: read.
